blocks.text: The Name Al-Kareem is found in three places in the Qur'aan,

And whoever is grateful, truly, his gratitude is for (the good of) his ownself, and whoever is ungrateful, (he is ungrateful only for the loss of his ownself). Certainly! My Lord is Rich (Free of all wants), Bountiful."
O man! What has made you careless concerning your Lord, the Most Generous?
So Exalted be Allah, the True King, La ilaha illa Huwa (none has the right to be worshipped but He), the Lord of the Supreme Throne!
For those who read the word 'al kareem' with a dammah it refers to an attribute of the Lord.
The Name Al-Akram is found in one place,
Read! And your Lord is the Most Generous.
It indicates the affirmation of generosity describing Allaah. The word 'Al-Karam' is all-encompassing to mean good virtues and praiseworthy descriptions - not only the meaning of 'giving'.
Giving is from the completion of its meaning. Due to this the people of knowledge have many sayings regarding the meaning of this Name:
1. Much good and giving.
2. Constantly doing good.
3. The One who has a mighty status and grand state.
4. One who is removed from having deficiencies and defects.
5. The One who is generous, the provider of blessings, the One who gives from His grace.
6. The One who gives not expecting anything in return.
7. The One who gives without a reason.
8. The One who gives the person who needs and the person who does not need.
9. The One who promises and fulfils it.
10. The One to whom every big and small need is raised to.
11. The One who does not abandon someone seeking nearness to Him nor One who leaves someone who calls upon Him.
12. The One who overlooks sins and forgives bad deeds.
There is more of what has been said about the meaning of this great Name. All of this is correct as this Name is from the Beautiful Names of Allaah that encompass multiple meanings not only one.
If a person considers everything that has been said about this Name, he will know that what is due to Allaah of this (from lofty meanings and honourable descriptions) cannot be counted and known.

keyPoints: Al-Kareem is found in three places in the Qur'aan, and Al-Akram in one place (Alaq 96:3).
These Names affirm generosity as a description of Allaah.
The word 'Al-Karam' is all-encompassing, meaning good virtues and praiseworthy descriptions, not only 'giving'; giving is from the completion of its meaning.

The people of knowledge gave many meanings, such as much good and giving, constantly doing good, giving without expecting anything in return, fulfilling promises, and overlooking sins and forgiving bad deeds.
All these meanings are correct, as this Name encompasses multiple meanings, and what is due to Allaah of them cannot be counted.

evidence.text: O man! What has made you careless concerning your Lord, the Most Generous?
Read! And your Lord is the Most Generous.

recall.a: The Generous; it affirms generosity for Allaah, and 'Al-Karam' encompasses good virtues and praiseworthy descriptions, not only giving.

recall.q: What does Al-Akram mean, and where is it found?
recall.a: The Most Generous; it is found in one place: "Read! And your Lord is the Most Generous." [Alaq 96:3].

recall.q: How many times is Al-Kareem found in the Qur'aan?
Give some of the meanings the people of knowledge mentioned for Al-Kareem.
recall.a: Much good and giving; constantly doing good; the One with a mighty status; removed from deficiencies; giving without expecting return; giving without a reason; promising and fulfilling; the One to whom every need is raised; overlooking sins and forgiving bad deeds.

recall.q: Why are all the different sayings about Al-Kareem's meaning correct?
recall.a: Because this Name is from the Beautiful Names of Allaah that encompass multiple meanings, not only one.
